name: month_offset
description: Produce a calendar month after a small signed month offset, ignoring year; matched controls read a marker in the same context.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
months=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];items=[];controls=[]
for i in range(120):
 d=i%12; n=random.choice([x for x in range(-6,7) if x]);tag=random.choice(['red','blue','green','gold']);direction='after' if n>0 else 'before'
 c=f'The starting month is {months[d]}. The shift is {abs(n)} months {direction} it. The marker is {tag}.'
 items.append({'prompt':c+' What month is reached? Answer with just the month name. Answer:','answer':' '+months[(d+n)%12]})
 controls.append({'prompt':c+' What is the marker? Answer with just the marker. Answer:','answer':' '+tag})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
